name: timestamps
description: A clock time and a relative age on every transcript row: prompts, replies, tool calls and results.

style.title: Time style (default: time)
style.description: How the clock reads. time: 24-hour, e.g. 09:12. time+seconds: 09:12:05. 12h: 9:12 AM. 12h+seconds: 9:12:05 AM. date+time: Oct 26 09:12. iso: 2026-10-26T09:12:05. custom: the pattern in Custom pattern.

pattern.title: Custom pattern (default: "HH:mm")
pattern.description: Used when Time style is custom. Tokens: YYYY (2026), MM (10), MMM (Oct), DD (26), ddd (Mon), HH (09), H (9), hh (12-hour, 09), h (12-hour, 9), mm (12), ss (05), a (AM or PM). Anything else is kept as typed, e.g. "ddd HH:mm".

showDate.title: Show date (default: other-day)
showDate.description: When the time, time+seconds, 12h and 12h+seconds styles add the date, e.g. Oct 26 09:12. other-day: on a row from another day. 12h: on a row older than 12 hours. 24h: older than 24 hours. 7d: older than 7 days. always: on every row. never: no date. A row with a date takes a wider column than the others, up to 22 cells or a quarter of the columns; the date is the first thing to drop when that is not enough.

show.title: Show (default: time)
show.description: What the stamp shows. time: the clock time only. age: how long ago, e.g. 5m ago. both: 09:12 · 5m ago. On the terminal's main screen rows show the clock only, since printed rows cannot update.

rows.title: Stamped rows (default: all)
rows.description: Which rows get a stamp. all: prompts, replies, tool calls, tool results, tool groups and command output. conversation: prompts and replies. prompts: your prompts only. no-tools: everything except tool calls, tool results and tool groups.

placement.title: Placement (default: auto)
placement.description: Where the stamp goes. auto: left from 70 columns, above the row below that and on mobile. left: a fixed-width column before the row, so every row's text starts at the same column. right: the same column after the row. above: one line above the row.

color.title: Colour (default: dim)
color.description: How the stamp is coloured. dim: the theme's dim text. subtle: the theme's subtle colour. time-of-day: by the hour of the row, in the colours of Day bands, dimmed. fixed: the Fixed colour. off: plain text.

fixedColor.title: Fixed colour (default: "inactive")
fixedColor.description: Used when Colour is fixed. A theme key (inactive, subtle, claude, success, warning, ...), a colour name such as cyan, or #rrggbb.

dayBands.title: Day bands (default: "6,12,18,22")
dayBands.description: Used when Colour is time-of-day. Four start hours, rising (0-23): morning (warning), afternoon (success), evening (claude), night (merged). Or two: day (warning) and night (merged), e.g. 7,19.

band.title: Last-activity band (default: off)
band.description: A line above the prompt with the time of your last prompt and Claude's last reply, e.g. you 09:12 · 5m ago   claude 09:14 · 3m ago. It follows Show. off: never. auto: on the terminal's main screen only, where printed rows cannot tick. on: always.
